subject: Math

definition: A statement that two expressions are equal.
kannadaDefinition: ಎರಡು ಉಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಸಮ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುವ ಹೇಳಿಕೆ.
subject: Math

definition: An expression with variables and whole-number exponents.
subject: Math

definition: An equation where the highest power of the variable is 2.
subject: Math

definition: The number multiplied by a variable in a term.
subject: Math

definition: The number showing how many times a base is multiplied by itself.
kannadaDefinition: ಆಧಾರವನ್ನು ಎಷ್ಟು ಬಾರಿ ತನ್ನಿಂದಲೇ ಗುಣಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.
subject: Math

definition: A number multiplied by itself; also a shape with four equal sides.
kannadaDefinition: ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಅದರಿಂದಲೇ ಗುಣಿಸಿದ ಫಲ; ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಮಬಾಹುಗಳ ಆಕೃತಿ.
subject: Math

definition: A number multiplied by itself three times; also a solid with six square faces.
kannadaDefinition: ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಮೂರು ಬಾರಿ ಗುಣಿಸಿದ ಫಲ; ಆರು ಚೌಕ ಮುಖಗಳ ಘನಾಕೃತಿ.
subject: Math

definition: The figure formed by two rays meeting at a point.
kannadaDefinition: ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರುವ ಎರಡು ಕಿರಣಗಳಿಂದ ಆಗುವ ಆಕೃತಿ.
subject: Math

definition: A closed shape with three sides.
example: The angles of a triangle add up to 180°.
subject: Math

definition: A round shape where every point is the same distance from the centre.
kannadaDefinition: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬಿಂದುಗಳು ಕೇಂದ್ರದಿಂದ ಸಮ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ದುಂಡನೆಯ ಆಕೃತಿ.
example: A wheel is shaped like a circle.
subject: Math

definition: Distance from the centre of a circle to its edge.
example: The radius is half the diameter.
subject: Math

definition: A straight line through the centre joining two points on a circle.
kannadaDefinition: ಕೇಂದ್ರದ ಮೂಲಕ ವೃತ್ತದ ಎರಡು ಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುವ ಸರಳ ರೇಖೆ.
example: The diameter of the plate is 20 cm.
subject: Math

definition: The distance around a circle.
subject: Math

definition: The amount of surface a shape covers.
example: The area of the room is 20 m².
subject: Math

definition: The total length around a shape.
example: A square of side 5 cm has a perimeter of 20 cm.
subject: Math

definition: Lines that never meet and stay the same distance apart.
subject: Math

definition: Meeting at a right angle (90°).
example: The walls are perpendicular to the floor.
subject: Math

definition: The longest side of a right-angled triangle.
example: Pythagoras' theorem relates the hypotenuse to the other sides.
subject: Math

definition: The sum of values divided by the number of values.
kannadaDefinition: ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಅವುಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿದ ಫಲ.
subject: Math

definition: The middle value when data is arranged in order.
subject: Math

definition: The value that appears most often in data.
subject: Math

definition: A well-defined collection of objects.
subject: Math

definition: A sequence where each term differs from the previous by a fixed amount.
kannadaDefinition: ಪ್ರತಿ ಪದವು ಹಿಂದಿನದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಿನ್ನವಾಗಿರುವ ಶ್ರೇಢಿ.
subject: Math

definition: The power to which a base must be raised to get a number.
kannadaDefinition: ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲು ಆಧಾರವನ್ನು ಏರಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಘಾತ.
subject: Math

definition: A pair of numbers that locates a point on a plane.
kannadaDefinition: ಸಮತಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಸ್ಥಾನ ತಿಳಿಸುವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಜೋಡಿ.
subject: Math

definition: A diagram showing the relation between quantities.
example: A bar graph shows marks of students.
subject: Math

definition: The result of adding numbers.
subject: Math

definition: The result of multiplying numbers.
subject: Math

definition: The result of dividing one number by another.
kannadaDefinition: ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಇನ್ನೊಂದರಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿದಾಗ ಬರುವ ಫಲ.
subject: Math

definition: The amount left over after division.
subject: Math
